      public void updateLeaderboard()

    • checkIfIsLapped

      public void checkIfIsLapped()
      This method is used to check if someone is lapped For each player, it checks if they are lapped, if yes it adds them to the lappedPlayers list Then it calls playerNoMoreInFlight that removes them from the leaderboard and adds them to the landedPlayers list
